subject: Encryption requirements & data handling — follow-up and next steps
messages:
From: Lauren Scott <lauren.scott@acme-fin.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: encryption & PII handling from today

Hi Soojin — thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and a few follow-ups from our security/product teams:

- PII scope: we classify account holder names, emails, and transaction IDs as PII. We need confirmation on which of these fields are persisted by Redwood for hosted inference.
- Retention: our policy is 30 days for any conversational traces unless explicitly retained for analytics. Can Redwood enforce a 30-day deletion policy per tenant?
- Logs & auditing: we require immutable audit logs for admin actions (30–90 day retention) and request-level logging for 7 days. Do you support export hooks to our S3?
- Data residency: data must remain in us-east-1 for this pilot. Can you pin region and attest to no cross-region backups?
- Encryption: confirm TLS in-transit and at-rest encryption. We also want customer-managed key support for production, and we need details on rotation policies and HSM-backed keys if available.

Can you respond with a concise list of capabilities and any blockers? We need this for our architecture review on Monday.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Scott
VP Product, Acme Financial
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Scott <lauren.scott@acme-fin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T17:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: encryption & PII handling from today

Hi Lauren — appreciate the clear list. Replying with a feature-level summary and proposed next steps. Attaching a short brief (redwood-encryption-brief.pdf) and a sample audit-log export (audit-log-sample.csv).

Summary of capabilities:
- PII persistence: Hosted API does not persist request/response content by default for production tenants unless logging/analysis is enabled. For the pilot we can enable "ephemeral mode" which purges conversational artifacts after a tenant-configured retention window (supports 1–90 days).
- Retention enforcement: Yes — per-tenant retention policies enforced by our ingestion pipeline. We can set 30-day automatic deletion; we also support manual retention holds for compliance reviews.
- Logs & auditing: We provide request-level logs (metadata + hashes, no raw prompt by default) for 7 days; admin/audit logs are immutable and exportable. We can push log exports to a customer S3 bucket (role-based access) on a daily cadence.
- Data residency: We can pin serving and storage to us-east-1 for the duration of the pilot. Backups are region-scoped by default; cross-region replication is opt-in and can be disabled.
- Encryption:
  - In-transit: TLS 1.2+ across all endpoints; mutual TLS available for private deployments.
  - At-rest: AES-256 encryption for model artifacts and storage.
  - Customer-managed keys: Supported in Dedicated and Private deployments via KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS). We also offer an HSM-backed option (partner HSM or customer HSM via BYOK exchange) for enterprise customers.
  - Rotation: Key rotation can be automated (managed by Redwood) or customer-driven; we support key versioning so existing tokens remain decryptable during rotation windows.

Open questions / potential blockers:
- For HSM-backed BYOK we need the customer's KMS/GCP/Azure account role to perform initial wrap/unwrap verification.
- Mutual TLS and private endpoint setup will require additional networking steps (VPC peering / private link) and lead time (typically 1–2 weeks).

Next steps proposed:
1) I will draft a short mutual action plan (MAP) with owners and timings.
2) Marissa will prepare an SOW estimate for Dedicated capacity with CMK/HSM add-on.
3) Karthik will scope the log export S3 workflow and provide sample IAM role policy.

Can you confirm that 30-day retention is acceptable and whether you prefer automated rotation (we manage rotation) or customer-driven rotation for the CMK?

Regards,

--
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Scott <lauren.scott@acme-fin.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-13T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: encryption & PII handling from today

Soojin — thanks, helpful. A couple quick clarifications:
- 30-day retention: confirmed, that works for the pilot.
- CMK rotation: for now we prefer customer-driven rotation; long-term we may evaluate automated rotation but need proof points.
- HSM: yes — we need to ensure FIPS 140-2 Level 3 or equivalent for production; can you include compliance posture in the brief?

Also, could you include a sample IAM policy we can hand to our cloud security to review?

Best,
Lauren
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Scott <lauren.scott@acme-fin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: encryption & PII handling from today

Thanks Lauren — noted. Action items and owners below; attaching the MAP spreadsheet (redwood-next-steps.xlsx) and a short compliance note that calls out HSM FIPS posture and the IAM snippet.

Action items:
- Marissa: SOW + pricing estimate for Dedicated + CMK/HSM option — ETA 2026-07-16.
- Karthik: S3 export IAM policy draft and sample CloudTrail integration notes — ETA 2026-07-15.
- Soojin: Draft MAP and coordinate initial onboarding call with your security team (propose 2026-07-20 10am ET). I will include a short checklist for the BYOK verification steps.

Quick answers to Lauren's asks:
- FIPS/HSM: Our HSM partner supports FIPS 140-2 Level 3 validated modules; we'll include the attestation language and a reference cert in the compliance note.
- IAM policy: included in attachments (also pasted below for quick copy).

IAM snippet (sample role trust + minimal s3 write for exports):

    "Version": "2012-10-17",
    "Statement": [
      {
        "Effect": "Allow",
        "Action": ["s3:PutObject", "s3:PutObjectAcl"],

(Full policy attached.)

Please confirm the proposed onboarding time and whether you want the initial call to include your infra/security folks plus our solutions engineer (Marissa) and Karthik.

Thanks — will follow up with the SOW and IAM policy file.
